name: Wan Chai grey-box circuit
_note: P0-5b. A compressed stand-in for the real circuit in docs/GAME_DESIGN.md: fast spine, elevated beat, technical parallel, cross-connector. Widths are stated as the real carriageway plus an explicit widen_factor so the arcade divergence stays visible and tunable — P1-4 reads the same shape from the ETL config rather than hardcoding it.

surface._note: road_lift_m keeps carriageways off the ground plane; coplanar slabs z-fight across their whole surface.

tram_street._road: Hennessy Road — tram reserve down the middle

buildings._note: Flanking massing only — enough to read as a corridor and to give the camera something to collide with. Real massing arrives in P1-2.

segments.name: Canal Road Flyover
segments._grade: 8 m rise over 133 m run = 6.0%, the same order as the real structure
